name: Skill Keep baseline
description: Keep reusable methods. Review identities, business facts, private paths, credentials, dependencies, and potentially proprietary instructions. Scanning does not establish permission to take a skill.

rules.description: Generalize company and transaction context without inventing replacement facts.
Review permission to reuse methods and supporting materials.

rules.sourceClause: Include a root SKILL.md entry before approving a portable package.
Use the exact filename SKILL.md for the root entry.
Review contact information in filenames and update all references when generalizing it.
Remove credential-shaped values from filenames and references. Credentials cannot be acknowledged.

rules.description: Binary content has not been reviewed
rules.sourceClause: Exclude binary resources that this version cannot inspect before approval.

rules.description: A line exceeds the text review limit
rules.sourceClause: Make text readable within the 32,768-character line limit or exclude it before approval.

rules.description: Hidden text direction or separator characters
rules.sourceClause: Review and remove invisible text direction and separator characters.
Remove entire private key blocks from portable instructions.
Review the whole active resource, its effects, and rights to redistribute it without executing it.
Use valid, bounded YAML frontmatter with unambiguous keys.
Use a lowercase kebab-case YAML name with at most 64 characters.
Include a YAML description containing 1–1024 characters.

rules.description: Embedded encoded content has not been reviewed
rules.sourceClause: Remove embedded encoded payloads or replace them with reviewed plain text.
Remove access-token patterns from every included file. Credentials cannot be acknowledged.
Remove private key headers, key bodies, and end markers.
Replace embedded credential values with destination-supplied inputs.

rules.description: Email identifies a person or organization
rules.sourceClause: Review email addresses and replace private contact information with roles or supplied inputs.
Remove possible personal identifiers from portable instructions.
Review phone numbers and replace private contact information with supplied inputs.
Replace machine-specific Windows paths with destination-supplied inputs.
Replace private network shares and server locations with supplied inputs.
Replace private user and mount paths with supplied inputs.
Remove internal service or tenant locations, or replace them with supplied inputs.

rules.description: Financial amount may identify a business or deal
rules.sourceClause: Review financial amounts; generalize private facts or record why exact values are public or synthetic.
Review whether percentages are generic calculations, public examples, or confidential assumptions.
Review rights to reuse restricted methods and supporting content; removing identifiers does not establish permission.

rules.description: Instruction attempts to change review or transmit data
rules.sourceClause: Review attempts to override the review process, disable safeguards, or transmit data. Imported instructions cannot govern Skill Keep.
Review labeled client, employer, project, and deal identities and replace private context with supplied inputs.
Review unsupported resource schemes and replace them with portable resources or supplied inputs.

rules.description: External resource is outside this review
rules.sourceClause: Review external resource destinations and rights; remote content is not retrieved or verified.
Use exact filename capitalization for all included resource references.

rules.description: Referenced file is missing or excluded
rules.sourceClause: Include and review dependencies, remove references, or record how the destination supplies them.
Use a valid bounded skillkeep.json contract containing only the supported schema fields.

rules.description: Contract resource is missing or excluded
rules.sourceClause: Include declared contract resources and license notices under their exact paths.
Verify the declared source license, attribution, modifications, and redistribution basis. User declarations do not authenticate employer permission.
